title: Simple Radial Menu Mod
description: Radial Menu is a lightweight, clean, and highly intuitive visual enhancement mod for Minecraft. It completely redesigns how you interact with your hotbar by a radial selection wheel.
body:
A lightweight and responsive visual enhancement for Minecraft 1.18.2 (Forge).

🎮 How to Use:
Press and hold R to view your items.
Move your cursor/touch over any item to preview its name in the center.
Release R to equip the selected item instantly.
